physical_problem.rotation_reference: world CG, full rotated dry inertia
physical_problem.observed_sea_role: separate future nonlinear case; not the linear reference forcing

cases.finite_response_set: Cartesian product; full radiation A/B, diffraction, Froude-Krylov, total excitation and coupled complex six-DOF RAO

reference_numerics.subdivision: Independently graded planar-facet triangles on the exact frozen surface; verified y=0 reflection; no smoothing or re-equilibration
reference_numerics.finite_green_settings: Capytaine 3.0.0 Delhommeau defaults, recorded in output

normalization.additional_matrix_diagnostic: full Cholesky whitening may be reported but cannot replace entrywise gates
normalization.excitation: rho*g*length^2 for translations, rho*g*length^3 for moments
normalization.rao: translation per unit elevation; rotation per unit elevation times hull length
normalization.hull_length: body-frame x extent of supplied full physical hull

acceptance.scope: initial linear verification policy; does not establish 60-second nonlinear motion accuracy
acceptance.reference_uncertainty: U=max(abs(Q4-Q3),abs(Q3-Q2)) componentwise on normalized real/complex quantities; empirical measured mesh uncertainty, not a certified continuum bound
acceptance.reference_trend: both finest increments <= reference_atol+reference_rtol*abs(Q4), and abs(Q4-Q3) <= abs(Q3-Q2)+reference_atol
acceptance.candidate_mesh_convergence: abs(Cfinest-Cprevious) <= candidate_atol+candidate_rtol*abs(Cfinest) entrywise after the same normalization; no single same-mesh pass
acceptance.complex_response: compare complex differences, not magnitudes alone; no phase-only test at zero amplitude
acceptance.policy_rationale: 0.1%/1% are predeclared linear engineering verification criteria, not derived motion-error budgets

required_before_enablement: complex response extraction and phase uncertainty
time_domain_wave_controls.revision_rule: resolve through a separately reviewed contract revision; no substitution of a frequency-domain runtime or archived diagnostic tank
